cohort: 505 nulliparous women ≥28 weeks gestation with a singleton pregnancy in two maternity hospitals in Sydney, Australia in 2018
finding: Women who attended psychoprophylaxis antenatal education showed a trend towards higher rates of vaginal birth, but this association was attenuated after adjusting for maternal characteristics and birth and hospital factors.
mod_finding: Women attending psychoprophylaxis antenatal education showed a trend towards higher vaginal birth rates, though not definitively conclusive.
